propositions: A reconcile pass must validate all mapped projects and legacy_default are visible to the bridge bot BEFORE any outbound mutation
Nonexistent or permission-lost mapped project keys pass syntactic validation but fail during fan-out as ACLI errors; preflight must catch these upfront
legacy_default is returned unvalidated from resolve_project and can drive mass CREATE operations into wrong/nonexistent projects; preflight must validate it
The preflight probes required projects via AcliClient._direct_rest_get against GET /rest/api/3/project/search with pagination and fails closed on transport errors or page-cap exhaustion
Preflight runs only for mutating passes and Cloud backends; read-only passes and non-Jira backends skip it and proceed unchanged
A failed preflight returns OPERATIONAL_FAILURE PassResult without calling reconcile_once; visible project set passes and proceeds normally
